ALMUQRIN FURNITURE FACTORY — FULL-STACK WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT PROMPT

You are a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, UI/UX Designer, 3D Web Developer, and Software Security Engineer.

Your task is to design, code, test, and prepare for deployment a production-quality bilingual corporate website for:

مصنع المقرن للأثاث والديكور
AlMuqrin Furniture & Decor Factory

Official domain: https://www.almuqrinfurniturefactory.com

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

1. Project Objective

Build a complete, elegant, modern corporate portfolio and digital furniture catalog website showcasing:

* Factory profile and capabilities.
* Furniture manufacturing services.
* Interior decoration services.
* Previous completed projects.
* Real project photography.
* Furniture collections and models.
* Interactive GLB/GLTF 3D furniture viewers.
* Product technical specifications.
* Custom furniture manufacturing.
* Quotation request forms.
* Factory contact information.
* Secure content management dashboard.

This is a corporate showroom and portfolio website, not an e-commerce store.

Do not implement a shopping cart, checkout, payment gateway, or public product prices.

2. Technology Stack

Use:

* Next.js with App Router.
* TypeScript with strict type checking.
* Tailwind CSS.
* shadcn/ui.
* Framer Motion or Motion.
* Three.js.
* React Three Fiber and Drei.
* Supabase for website content storage, subject to secure configuration.
* React Hook Form and Zod.
* next-intl for Arabic/English localization.
* Lucide icons.

Follow current stable package versions and their official documentation.

Use reusable components, server-side rendering where appropriate, accessible HTML, responsive layouts, and SEO-friendly architecture.

3. Visual Design System

Create a premium architectural furniture design language.

Colors:

:root {
  --primary: #101d35;
  --primary-dark: #091326;
  --silver: #b9c2cc;
  --background: #f7f8fa;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --text-primary: #172235;
  --text-secondary: #64748b;
  --border: #e2e8f0;
}

Design requirements:

* Luxury minimal style.
* Navy and silver branding.
* Large editorial furniture photographs.
* Smooth scroll animations.
* Elegant hover transitions.
* Responsive navigation.
* Sticky transparent-to-solid header.
* Arabic RTL and English LTR layouts.
* Mobile-first implementation.
* Light and dark presentation support.
* Clean typography and generous spacing.
* Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Use the actual factory logo from supplied assets. Never invent or replace the brand identity.

4. Website Pages and Routes

Implement:

/
├── /ar
│   ├── /about
│   ├── /services
│   │   └── /[slug]
│   ├── /catalog
│   │   └── /[slug]
│   ├── /projects
│   │   └── /[slug]
│   ├── /manufacturing
│   ├── /request-quote
│   └── /contact
│
├── /en
│   └── Equivalent English routes
│
└── /admin
    ├── /dashboard
    ├── /products
    ├── /projects
    ├── /services
    ├── /media
    └── /quote-requests

Implement locale-aware routing, canonical URLs, and hreflang metadata.

5. Homepage Components

Build these components:

<Navbar />
<HeroSection />
<FactoryIntroduction />
<ServicesGrid />
<FeaturedFurniture />
<ThreeDShowcase />
<FeaturedProjects />
<ManufacturingProcess />
<FactoryGallery />
<WhyChooseUs />
<QuoteCallToAction />
<ContactSection />
<Footer />

Hero content in Arabic:

مصنع المقرن للأثاث والديكور

من التصميم إلى التصنيع… نصنع التفاصيل بإتقان.

Description:

“نقدم حلولاً متكاملة لتصميم وتصنيع وتنفيذ الأثاث والديكورات للمنازل والمكاتب والمشاريع التجارية، وفق أعلى معايير الجودة والدقة في التنفيذ.”

Buttons:

* استكشف أعمالنا
* تصفح الموديلات
* اطلب عرض سعر

6. Factory Services

Build dedicated service cards and detail pages for:

1. Office furniture and workstations.
2. Executive offices and meeting tables.
3. Residential furniture and bedrooms.
4. Sofas, majlis seating, and upholstery.
5. Custom cabinetry and wardrobes.
6. Wooden wall decorations and TV units.
7. Commercial interior fit-outs.
8. Curtains and interior finishing.
9. Doors and custom woodworking.
10. Custom furniture design and manufacturing.

Each service must support real photos, descriptions, technical information, related models, and quotation requests.

7. Product Catalog and 3D Models

Create a database-driven furniture catalog.

Each product must support:

type FurnitureProduct = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  sku: string;
  nameAr: string;
  nameEn: string;
  descriptionAr: string;
  descriptionEn: string;
  categoryId: string;
  images: string[];
  model3dUrl?: string;
  dimensions?: {
    width?: number;
    height?: number;
    depth?: number;
    unit: "mm" | "cm";
  };
  materials?: string[];
  finishes?: string[];
  featured: boolean;
  published: boolean;
};

Implement:

* Category filtering.
* Text search.
* Product detail pages.
* Image galleries.
* Zoom functionality.
* Related products.
* GLB/GLTF model viewing.
* Orbit controls.
* Automatic camera framing.
* Environment lighting.
* Model loading progress.
* Graceful fallback to product photography.
* Quotation CTA.

Critical requirement: Every 3D model must belong to its correct furniture product. Never reuse a generic model to falsely represent another product.

If product photographs are available without a corresponding 3D model, display the photographs and mark the model as unavailable.

Do not claim photorealistic geometric accuracy for models reconstructed without verified dimensions and reference data.

8. Previous Projects Portfolio

Create a professional portfolio with:

* Project categories.
* Gallery layouts.
* Project descriptions.
* Manufacturing photographs.
* Installation photographs.
* Before/after comparisons where genuine.
* Project videos where available.
* Related manufacturing services.
* Request a similar project CTA.

Use real completed-project assets only.

Keep concept designs and uncompleted work clearly separated from completed projects.

Do not publish confidential customer information.

9. Quotation Request System

Build a secure quote request form.

Fields:

type QuoteRequest = {
  customerName: string;
  companyName?: string;
  phone: string;
  email?: string;
  city: string;
  serviceType: string;
  projectDescription: string;
  quantity?: number;
  preferredDate?: string;
  attachments?: string[];
};

Requirements:

* Zod validation.
* Secure server-side submission.
* File type and size validation.
* Rate limiting.
* Spam protection.
* Private attachment storage.
* Database persistence.
* Request reference number.
* Admin review workflow.
* Submission confirmation.
* Saudi privacy requirements.

Never expose private customer attachments through public URLs.

10. Secure Admin Dashboard

Create authenticated admin functionality for:

* Product management.
* Model image uploads.
* GLB model uploads.
* Project portfolio management.
* Services content.
* Quote requests.
* Media library.
* Arabic/English content.
* Publication status.

Use strict authorization, server-side permission checks, Supabase RLS, and audit logging.

Test unauthorized access, direct API calls, cross-role access, and file-upload security.

11. Image Management

Support uploaded factory photography.

Implement:

* Original image preservation.
* Optimized image variants.
* WebP/AVIF delivery.
* Lazy loading.
* Responsive image dimensions.
* Descriptive alt text.
* Image compression.
* Factory watermark overlays for published photographs.

Use the factory’s official logo as the watermark with configurable opacity.

Do not modify source images destructively.

12. SEO and Performance

Implement:

* Metadata for every page.
* Open Graph.
* JSON-LD structured data.
* XML sitemap.
* Robots.txt.
* Canonical URLs.
* Arabic and English SEO.
* Optimized fonts.
* Dynamic imports for heavy 3D viewers.
* Efficient caching.
* Core Web Vitals optimization.
* Accessible keyboard navigation.

13. Deployment Architecture

Primary public website:

https://www.almuqrinfurniturefactory.com

Separate internal platform:

https://app.almuqrinfurniturefactory.com

The internal platform and corporate website must remain logically and operationally separate.

Do not modify the existing factory ERP, accounting, payroll, orders, manufacturing, or internal database.

If existing code is provided, first inspect its routes, dependencies, database schema, assets, and deployment configuration. Preserve working functionality and existing content.

Do not replace existing production infrastructure or modify DNS without explicit authorization.

14. Testing and Quality Assurance

Execute:

npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm run build

Add and run tests for:

* Homepage rendering.
* Arabic and English localization.
* RTL/LTR switching.
* Responsive navigation.
* Product category filters.
* Product detail routes.
* Image rendering.
* GLB model loading.
* Missing 3D model fallback.
* Quote submission.
* Admin access control.
* File upload validation.
* SEO metadata.
* Broken image and link detection.

Use Playwright for browser-based end-to-end testing and inspect mobile and desktop layouts.

Do not report a test as passed unless it was actually executed successfully.

15. Deliverables

Provide:

1. Complete application source code.
2. Reusable components and design system.
3. Fully implemented responsive pages.
4. Database migrations and RLS policies.
5. Secure content administration.
6. Working image and 3D model support.
7. Bilingual content configuration.
8. Environment variable template without secrets.
9. Deployment configuration.
10. Test scripts and results.
11. README documentation.
12. Inventory of imported assets and their product mappings.

16. Execution Instructions

Work in implementation phases:

Phase 1: Inspect the project and available assets.

Phase 2: Build architecture, routing, and design system.

Phase 3: Implement homepage and all corporate pages.

Phase 4: Import the genuine furniture photos and build the catalog.

Phase 5: Implement individual GLB viewers and product mapping.

Phase 6: Build the project portfolio and quote request workflow.

Phase 7: Implement secure content administration.

Phase 8: Run security, accessibility, performance, build, and browser tests.

Phase 9: Produce a deployment-ready build and verification report.

Do not stop after creating a UI mockup.

Generate real, maintainable, executable code, verify your implementation, and document any incomplete integration or unavailable asset.

Do not deploy or change production infrastructure without explicit approval.

Final goal: Build a premium bilingual digital showroom for AlMuqrin Furniture & Decor Factory, combining genuine furniture photography, project showcases, interactive 3D models, manufacturing services, and customer quotation workflows.
